0022600115.text: The Timberwolves, 2-0 with a two-game win streak and 2-0 on the road, host the Raptors, who are also 2-0, in a matchup between two unbeaten teams. Minnesota is 3rd in the Northwest and 6th in the West, while Toronto is 2nd in the Atlantic, 0.5 games back, and 3rd in the East. Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery), and Toronto is missing Brandon Ingram (out, heel surgery), Kawhi Leonard (out, knee inflammation), and Nate Bittle (out, foot fracture). The teams have not yet met in 2026-27, but Minnesota won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 115-107 win in Minneapolis on March 5, 2026.
